info.name: Brew Go API v1
info.description: Run the folders in order (Runner). Needs the API running at {{baseUrl}}.

body.raw:
{
  "fullName": "Test Student",
  "email": "student{{$timestamp}}@example.com",
  "phone": "9{{$randomInt}}",
  "address": "123 Sample St, Iligan City",
  "password": "Brewgo2026",
  "acceptTerms": true
}

exec: pm.test("201 created OR 422 if the random phone is invalid", () => pm.expect([201,422]).to.include(pm.response.code));
